metadata.title: Azita Mohajer · Consultation platform
metadata.description: A focused case study of a Persian consultation platform spanning booking, secure administration and a companion Telegram bot.

hero.title: One consultation journey, wherever people start.
hero.intro: A Persian-first product that turns choosing a service, finding a Jalali date and following up on a request into one clear flow.

live.title: Explore the real booking experience.
live.description: Open the public website or continue the same journey through the Telegram bot.

screenshot.alt: Azita Mohajer homepage and four-step consultation booking flow

product.title: Booking and operations in one system.
product.description: The public experience stays simple while a separate administrative workspace handles the operational detail behind every booking.

features.title: Guided booking
features.text: A clear four-step path from personal details to a confirmed consultation slot.

features.title: Jalali scheduling
features.text: Localized dates and available times make the flow natural for Persian speakers.

features.title: Telegram companion
features.text: Users can book and follow up without leaving a familiar messaging environment.

features.title: Secure operations
features.text: Roles, protected access and activity records keep requests organized behind the scenes.

engineering.title: A full-stack booking foundation.
engineering.description: The stack connects a localized web experience, relational booking data and Telegram automation without exposing the private admin surface.

notes.title: Typed relational data
notes.text: PostgreSQL and Drizzle model booking, schedule and administrative workflows.

notes.title: Persian-first interface
notes.text: RTL layout, Jalali dates and localized interaction details shape the whole product.

notes.title: Protected administration
notes.text: Authentication, roles and audit-friendly records isolate operational access.
